+
+Coverage notes: the engine hung 30 minutes on the full range (third hang in two days); the two rename commits were verified mechanically instead — diff confirmed rename-only content, full suite green (163 tests / 29 suites). The feature commit 54d7f24 got a real engine pass with one finding, below.
+
+⚠️ EVIDENCE AGAINST FINDING 1 — likely engine false positive from missing cross-file scope: `resolveOnce` IS defined (Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/PromptCacheTestSupport.swift:88, internal, same target), the target compiles, and the cited test passes: `swift test --filter configurableChunkSizeRoundTripsWithReuse` → "3 test cases passed". Inlining or redefining the helper would create the duplication the duplication validator forbids. Recommend checking this off as no-change-needed after confirming the same evidence.
+
+## Review Findings (2026-07-10 23:27)
+
+- [ ] `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/PromptCacheChunkTests.swift:318` — Test `configurableChunkSizeRoundTripsWithReuse` claims to verify round-trip store→resolve behavior but references undefined function `resolveOnce`, so the resolve (read) direction of the round-trip cannot actually execute. The test label promises to verify 'round-trips' and the docstring describes testing 'second resolve of an extension', but this inverse operation is unverifiable because the function does not exist. Define a `resolveOnce` helper function wrapping the PromptCache.resolve call, or inline the call: `let resolved = await cache.resolve(modelID: modelID, newTokens: extensionTokens, model: SendableBox(model), parameters: nil).consume()`, then extract `resolved.tokensToFeed` to verify the reuse assertion.
\ No newline at end of file
